title: Jadarian Price Out of Chargers Game with Chest Injury
seoTitle: Jadarian Price Out of Chargers Game with Chest Injury
subtitle: Seahawks Rookie Aggravates Injury, Sidelined for Week 4 Game
excerpt: Running back Jadarian Price, a first-round pick for the Seattle Seahawks, has been ruled out for the clash against the Los Angeles Chargers after aggravating an injury.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Jadarian Price, the Seattle Seahawks rookie, has been ruled out for the Week 4 game against the Los Angeles Chargers after aggravating the chest injury he had been carrying since the victory over the Arizona Cardinals in the second round.

Jadarian Price's Injury and Upcoming Absence

Head coach Mike Macdonald explained that Price practiced in a limited capacity on Wednesday but ended up worsening the injury during the training session. He did not practice on Thursday or Friday and was declared unavailable for the matchup at Lumen Field.

How the Absence Affects the Seahawks' Running Game

With Price out, Seattle's offensive plan will rely more on George Holani and Emanuel Wilson. Last week, Wilson led the team in rushing attempts (32), followed by Price (28) and Holani (15). Although Wilson has more carries, his yards per attempt (3.5 yards) is below Price's average (4.3 yards).

Emanuel Wilson and George Holani's Performance

Wilson has been the more reliable runner, especially in the red zone, where he recorded nine attempts compared to Holani's six. Holani, on the other hand, excels in the passing game, averaging two receptions per game with an 86% catch rate, while Wilson has no recorded receptions yet.

Outlook for Price's Return

Macdonald stated that he does not yet know Price's recovery timeline and that the injury may or may not become a long-term concern. The coach emphasized that the situation is no one's fault and that the player has a good attitude and a promising future.

Impact on Fantasy Football Strategies

For fantasy team owners, Price's unavailability requires adjustments. While Wilson remains the higher-volume option, Holani can be used as a substitute in situations of need, although he is not yet considered a starting asset.

With information from Seattle Seahawks, Sports Illustrated.
